scripts.label: Tactic fork played
scripts.text: The idea is a fork in this continuation. One piece attacks several targets at once.

scripts.label: Tactic fork allowed
scripts.text: This move allows a fork in the continuation. One opposing piece attacks several targets at once.

scripts.label: Tactic pin played
scripts.text: The continuation uses a pin. Moving the pinned piece off the line would expose its king.

scripts.label: Tactic pin allowed
scripts.text: This move allows a pin in the continuation. Moving the pinned piece off the line would expose its king.

scripts.label: Tactic pin missed
scripts.text: The stronger continuation used a pin. Moving the pinned piece off the line would expose its king.

scripts.label: Tactic skewer played
scripts.text: The continuation uses a skewer. Moving the front piece exposes a piece behind it.

scripts.label: Tactic skewer allowed
scripts.text: This move allows a skewer in the continuation. Moving the front piece exposes a piece behind it.

scripts.label: Tactic skewer missed
scripts.text: The stronger continuation had a skewer. Moving the front piece would expose a piece behind it.

scripts.label: Tactic removing defender played
scripts.text: The continuation removes a defender by capture. Notice what loses protection when that defender disappears.

scripts.label: Tactic removing defender allowed
scripts.text: This move allows the other side to capture a defender in the continuation. Notice what loses protection when that defender disappears.

scripts.label: Tactic removing defender missed
scripts.text: The stronger continuation captured a defender. That was the chance to remove protection from what it was guarding.

scripts.label: Tactic back rank played
scripts.text: The continuation ends in checkmate on the back rank. The king's own pieces take away escape squares.

scripts.label: Tactic back rank allowed
scripts.text: This move allows a back-rank checkmate in the continuation. The king's own pieces take away escape squares.

scripts.label: Tactic back rank missed
scripts.text: The stronger continuation ended in a back-rank checkmate. This move lets that finish go.

scripts.label: Tactic promotion awareness played
scripts.text: The continuation includes a pawn promotion. Follow the pawn all the way to its last rank.

scripts.label: Tactic promotion awareness allowed
scripts.text: This move allows the opposing pawn to promote in the continuation. Follow that pawn all the way to its last rank.

scripts.label: Tactic promotion awareness missed
scripts.text: The stronger continuation included a pawn promotion. This move misses that opportunity.

scripts.label: Tactic discovered attack played
scripts.text: The continuation uses a discovered attack. Moving one piece opens an attacking line for another.

scripts.label: Tactic discovered attack allowed
scripts.text: This move allows a discovered attack in the continuation. Moving one opposing piece opens an attacking line for another.

scripts.label: Tactic discovered attack missed
scripts.text: The stronger continuation used a discovered attack. Moving one piece would open an attacking line for another.
